# immich_asset_statistics (Data Source)

Get statistics about Immich assets

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_asset_statistics" "all" {
}

data "immich_asset_statistics" "favourites" {
  is_favourite = true
}

data "immich_asset_statistics" "hidden" {
  is_hidden = true
}

data "immich_asset_statistics" "archive" {
  visibility = "archive"
}

data "immich_asset_statistics" "timeline" {
  visibility = "timeline"
}

data "immich_asset_statistics" "hidden" {
  visibility = "hidden"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_favorite` (Boolean) If true, show only assets that have been marked as favourites.
- `is_trashed` (Boolean) If true, show only assets that have been put in the bin.
- `visibility` (String) Filter by visibility state. Options are 'archive', 'timeline', 'hidden' or 'locked'.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Number) Number of image assets.
- `total` (Number) Total number of assets.
- `videos` (Number) Number of video assets.
